verdict.rationale: Cooley runs a firm-owned AI company and the Cooley GO document generators that take user input, so asking whether user data can be kept out of AI training is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence describes an AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training-exclusion control. The Cyber/Data/Privacy item describes legal advisory services for clients, not the product's own handling of user data, so it does not count here.
